recipes.name: 4-Cheese Lasagna inspired by One Piece
ingredients: 1 lb hot Italian sausage, casings removed
1 lb sweet Italian sausage, casings removed
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 lb no boil lasagna noodles, for flat layers
1 lb low moisture mozzarella, thinly sliced
instructions: For the Red Sauce
In a large Dutch oven over medium high heat, add oil. - 2 tbsp neutral oil
Remove the Italian sausage from their casings. - 1 lb hot Italian sausage casings removed - 1 lb sweet Italian sausage casings removed

Once the oil is shimmering, add the Italian sausage to the pot and using a wooden spoon or potato masher, break it up into small pieces. - 1 lb hot Italian sausage casings removed - 1 lb sweet Italian sausage casings removed
Cook until the sausage is golden brown and crisp, about 10-15 minutes. Dice the onions and mince the garlic in the meantime. - 2 small yellow onions diced
Once the sausage is cooked, add the onions and stir to combine. Cook for 6-8 minutes, or until the onions turn mostly translucent and begin to brown around the edges. - 2 small yellow onions diced
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant. - 4 garlic cloves minced

Add tomato paste, oregano and basil and stir to combine. Cook the tomato paste for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent burning. The tomato paste should darken in color. - ¼ cup tomato paste - 1 tbsp dried oregano - 1 tbsp dried basil

Once the tomato paste has cooked, add the crushed tomatoes and use the wooden spoon to release any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Season with salt, pepper and sugar (if needed). - 2 (28 oz) cans crushed tomatoes - kosher salt to taste - freshly ground black pepper to taste - sugar if needed
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the flavors have married and the meat is tender. - For the Red Sauce
Remove from the heat and set aside until ready for assembly. - For the Red Sauce
While the Red Sauce is cooking, make the Ricotta Mixture.
When the sauce is finished simmering, optionally blitz with an immersion blender if it’s too chunky. - For the Red Sauce
For the Ricotta Mixture
In a large mixing bowl, add all ingredients and stir well to combine. Refrigerate until ready to use. - 1 lb whole milk ricotta cheese - 2 eggs well beaten - ½ cup finely grated pecorino cheese
For the Assembly
Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Begin with 1-2 ladles of the Red Sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch (23x33 cm) baking dish, or until the bottom is just barely covered with red sauce. - For the Red Sauce
Then add a layer of noodles, followed by another few ladles of sauce. - 1 lb no boil lasagna noodles for flat layers - For the Red Sauce

Repeat this process 4 times, or until your pasta fills about 60% of the height of the casserole dish. Once the final layer of no-bake lasagna has been added, top it with the entire bowl of the Ricotta mixture and use an offset spatula to spread evenly along the top. - For the Ricotta Mixture
Finalize with a thin layer of equal parts mozzarella and parmesan cheese. - 1 lb low moisture mozzarella thinly sliced - ½ cup parmesan finely grated
Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes, then remove the foil and broil for 5-10 minutes.
Remove from the oven once the top is bubbly and brown. Allow it to rest for 30 minutes, then cut, garnish with fresh basil leaves, and serve. - 2 ½ fresh basil leaves
